get.description: Queries one half-open source range of at most 31 days. Before sidecar or source access, the request is limited to the configured number of intersecting sealed segments (default 1024, operator range 1..=4096). Decoded-memory and valid sibling-OVF hits bypass source-build admission. A selected source read failure returns an uncached partial 200 response with an explicit known gap; FIFO rejection or timeout returns cold_build_overloaded. Admitted work remains limited to 1,048,576 retained observations and a 64 MiB cloned-observation charge.

200.description: Event and health summary of the range

get.description: Queries a canonical source set over a half-open range of at most 31 days. Before sidecar or source access, one aggregate limit applies to intersecting sealed segments across the deduplicated source set (default 1024, operator range 1..=4096). Decoded-memory and valid sibling-OVF hits bypass source-build admission; selected source failures remain explicit partial gaps, while FIFO rejection or timeout returns cold_build_overloaded. A cursor pins a process-local view: after a process restart it returns cursor_expired with HTTP 410, while a new ordinary query can regenerate the same data. Admitted work remains limited to 1,048,576 retained observations and a 64 MiB cloned-observation charge.
